verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes its own API reference: endpoint pages such as send-calls and create-api-key, plus a machine-readable OpenAPI spec served at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json. The evidence does not show that this reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, so only the reference itself is substantiated. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key

Your agent (or its provider's post-call webhook) POSTs here with the transcript, recording URL, and metadata; Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
